lessons.title: Practice Constant vs Linear Lookup
lessons.description: Compare list membership (O(n)) vs set membership (O(1) average). Implement has_in_set(items, target). The test checks that has_in_set([1, 2, 3], 2) is true; has_in_set([1, 2, 3], 9) is false.
learning_objectives: This step reads the first item in one step, using items holding violet.
lessons.solution_code:
def has_in_set(items, target):
    return target in set(items)

source.name: Python official documentation (docs.python.org) — Time complexity of operations on built-in types — 'x in s' is O(1) for sets, O(n) for lists
